info.name: English Meaning
info.value: to shine,to burn,to be illustrious, to glow

examples: 'agniM na mA maTitaM saM didIpaH' (f॰8.48.6). prajvalaya prakASaya BAsayetyAha.
'sandIpte Bavane tu kUpaKananaM pratyudyamaH kIdfSaH' (Bartf॰3.77). sandIpte=dagDe.
'kzaRena sarve vihitAH pradIpA vyAdIpayanto DvajinIM tavASu' (BA0 droRa0 163.17). vyAdIpayantaH=saviSezaM prakASayantaH.
'AdIpakasya stenasya varRasaMkarikasya ca' (BA0 SAM0 85.22). AdIpako gfhAdidAhakaH, agnidaH.
'sostraM tadaBidIpyantamApatantaM SitEH SarEH. tastamBe bARajAlena' (hari0 2.73.46).. aBidIpyantam=aBidIpyat, aBimuKaM jvalat. aBidIpyantamApatantamiti puMsi prayogO duzyataH.
